enunciado: Define the class Rectangle with attributes base and height, a constructor and the methods area(), perimeter() and scale(factor). Create two rectangles, scale one and show their areas and perimeters.
objetivos: Declare a class with attributes and methods
Create objects with new and send them messages
See that each object has its own state
pistas: this.base refers to the attribute of the current object.
The constructor has the same name as the class.
Scaling one does not change the other: they are different objects.
